title: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29): Administrators can turn SIFT (SumIndexField Technology) indexes on/off
summary: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29) enables administrators to turn SIFT (SumIndexField Technology) indexes on and off directly within the application. SIFT indexes optimize performance of FlowFields and query results by quickly calculating sums of numeric columns, and administrators can now manage them through Index Management or Table Information pages.
key_points: Administrators can switch SIFT indexes on or off from the Business Central client
Index Management is reached via Tell Me or by clicking a Table No. on Table Information
A new Index Type field tells regular database indexes apart from SIFT structures
Turning an index back on is queued for the next overnight maintenance window
Custom SIFT fields can be managed the same way

quotes.text: The index has been enqueued to be turned on. It will be attempted during the subsequent maintenance window (overnight local time).
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the asynchronous process for index changes
